import subprocess,sys,re
db=next(x for x in subprocess.check_output(["docker","ps","--format","{{.Names}}"],text=True).splitlines() if re.search(r"postgres|database|db-[0-9]",x,re.I))
sql="""SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,title FROM posting_topics WHERE chat_id IN (-1002373696859,-1003770334893)
AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND (title ILIKE '%チャット%' OR title ILIKE '%見せ合い%') ORDER BY chat_id"""
p=subprocess.run(["docker","exec",db,"sh","-c",'psql -qAt -F "|" -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "$1"',"sh",sql],capture_output=True,text=True)
if p.returncode:sys.exit(90)
rows=[line.split("|") for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
if len(rows)!=2:sys.exit(91)
v=next((r for r in rows if r[0]=="-1002373696859"),None)
g=next((r for r in rows if r[0]=="-1003770334893"),None)
if not v or not g:sys.exit(92)
sys.exit(100+(int(v[1])==1605)*1+(int(g[1])==4)*2)
